brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Unclear; no App uses it. Likely archiving Peekbank-format eye-tracking datasets.

**Not for:** Use before owner review: the record says 'TBD' and no App reads it.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/behavior.eyetracking.peekbank.json

files.desc: Peekbank aoi_timepoints: area-of-interest looked at per time point.
Peekbank AOI region coordinates on the stimulus screen.
Peekbank datasets table: source dataset and citation.
Peekbank subjects table: participant codes, age and sex.
Peekbank trials table: trial order and stimuli.
Peekbank xy_timepoints: raw gaze coordinates per time point.

identifying_risks: Child participants; age and sex in small samples.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: coded participant-level behavioural data; step 8 for small child samples.
sharing_cautions: Check subjects.csv for identifiers and consent for child data.
